About

KDN draw on rhythmic and sonic traditions from the motherland: beats, bass grooves and the euphoric sunshine of Congolese guitars. African dance music meets jazz, with polyrhythmic guitars, horns and vocals, which they call pure Afro-joy.

Highlights

  • African dance music fused with jazz
  • Polyrhythmic guitars, horns and vocals
